name: AutoHedge
description: Build your autonomous hedge fund in minutes. AutoHedge harnesses the power of swarm intelligence and AI agents to automate market analysis, risk management, and trade execution.
one_liner: A code framework that sets up a team of AI 'agents' to research trades, decide risk levels, and place real cryptocurrency trades automatically with your wallet's private key.
buyer: Honestly, there isn't a sound buyer here — this hands an AI system autonomous control of a real wallet's funds with no regulatory oversight, and 'AI picks and trades for you' tools have a long track record of losing users money.
business_use_cases: N/A — running this against real funds is a financial-risk product, not a business use case; a company doing this without licensing is likely operating as an unregistered investment adviser in most jurisdictions.
A quant hobbyist could study the multi-agent pipeline pattern (thesis → risk sizing → execution) purely as a code architecture reference for other AI-agent-pipeline projects, unrelated to trading.

money_ideas.idea: None responsible — charging customers to run their money through an autonomous trading bot exposes both the operator and customers to major financial and regulatory risk; not a business to build.

steal_this: Skip the trading angle entirely. The genuinely useful and safe piece to borrow is the multi-agent pipeline pattern itself (planner → analyst → risk-checker → executor) — apply that structure to a non-financial task instead.
